rows.reasoning: The only evidence is Wiener's Aye on ACA 5 (2023-2024), which repeals the man-woman-only clause and provides that "The right to marry is a fundamental right"; the Senate Floor tally was "Ayes Count 31 Noes Count 0 NVR Count 9", so under the near-unanimous rule this vote cannot carry a chair on its own. Its content would point at "Guarantee same-sex marriage the same benefits and protections as any other marriage" rather than the jobs-and-housing clause or the religious-organization carve-out, but no surviving passage supports a chair.
